text:
maya: planning huddle  we need to finalise the Optimize toolkit slice for next sprint. two customer asks rolled in: HelixMed needs deterministic cache invalidation + per-route TTLs; DataSense wants model-quant suggestions to reduce tokens/cost. ops also asked for eval-triggered regressions. can we scope this?

kyle: realistically, batching presets + TTL UI + a basic invalidate API fits one sprint. quant advisor requires offline eval, so plan for a follow-up sprint.

rita: priority wise HelixMed is blocking onboarding. suggest sprint-1 = batching presets + invalidate + TTL controls. sprint-2 = quant advisor + eval-alerts.

josh: agree. but include a minimal "eval smoke" in sprint-1 for any canary that changes output. simple checks: 8-10 representative prompts.

lea: UX notes: TTL control should be in route settings (dropdown + custom). add a one-click "Invalidate cache" and a small confirmation modal. tooltip: suggested TTL = 30s/5m/1h. docs blurb + email template for HelixMed.

kyle: dev estimates: batching presets (2 dev-days), cache API + invalidate event + audit row (5 dev-days), UI + docs (2 dev-days), eval-smoke harness (2 dev-days). quant advisor (3-4w).

maya: acceptance criteria (sprint-1):
- batching: per-route presets (fast/standard/bulk) apply without degrading p95 beyond 1.2x baseline
- cache: POST /routes/{id}/invalidate implemented; TTL per-route configurable; invalidate writes audit log entry with actor
- rollout: FF -> internal -> HelixMed canary 48-72h -> alpha
- eval-smoke: run 10 smoke prompts during canary, no large semantic drift per smoke set

rita: monitoring gates: p95 latency <= 1.25x baseline; error-rate delta < 0.4% for 5m windows. stop if consecutive 3 checks fail.

josh: risk callouts: cached prefix collisions for shared-model routes; default to eventual consistency. provide a feature-flag for strong-consistency invalidation (higher latency). KV quota might delay audit durability; fallback = in-memory TTL for pilot only. must document caveats.

lea: acceptance for UI: TTL dropdown + custom input present; invalidate triggers confirmation and yields audit row; tooltip copy written in PR.

kyle: rollout plan detail: behind FF -> internal smoke -> HelixMed canary -> monitor eval-smoke + infra metrics -> expand. stop conditions: p50 latency regress > 12% or 5m error spike >0.6%.

maya: sprint-2 sketch: quant advisor initial alpha will produce per-route suggestions (e.g., q4_0 vs int8) + expected cost delta estimate; gated by automated eval alerts. gating metrics proposal from ops: mean token logprob delta > 0.5 or semantic overlap drop > 3% trigger alert. store per-route baselines for 90 days.

rita: comms: I'll draft customer note for HelixMed explaining fallback limits and expected behaviour.

josh: owners: batching=kyle; cache API=kyle; UI=lea; docs/comms=rita; eval-smoke=josh; quant-advisor infra=kyle+platform.

deploy-bot: CI 1798765448 feat/toolkit-slim build passed (9m) :white_check_mark:

maya: thanks team. I'll lock scope to sprint-1 as discussed and push updated roadmap + invite for 20m kickoff tomorrow 9:30am. :tada:
